title: Cancer Chemopreventive Potential and Chemical Profiling of Euphorbia abyssinica Endowed with Docking Studies.
authors: Ahmed, Shaimaa R; Hamed, Ahmed R; Ali, Mohammed I; Sedeek, Mohamed S; Abelyan, Narek; Al-Sanea, Mohammad M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大戟提取物的化学组成、抗氧化及NQO1诱导活性，并含KEAP1靶点的分子对接，但核心是植物化学与癌症预防，蛋白质-DNA互作仅间接涉及KEAP1转录调控，非TF-DNA结合体系，方法上仅简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Chemical profiling of both fruit and aerial part extracts of Euphorbia abyssinica via ultra-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS) showed them to be a rich source of diverse compounds. A total of 39 compounds in both extracts including flavonoids and phenolic compounds were identified as predominant metabolites. The antioxidant activity of both extracts was evaluated using three different in vitro assays (DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays). The E. abyssinica fruit extract demonstrated more potent activity compared to the aerial part extract (IC(50) of 85.1 +/- 1.07 and 562.3 +/- 1.01 mug/mL, respectively) in the DPPH assay. Furthermore, using ABTS and FRAP assays, the antioxidant capacities of the fruit extract were 1063.03 +/- 37.8 and 1476.5 +/- 95.6, respectively, calculated as muM Trolox equivalent/mg extract. One of the existing markers for cancer chemoprevention is the induction of phase II detoxifying enzyme NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1), which plays a vital role in cytoprotection against oxidative damage. The extracts were assessed to test their chemopreventive potential via NQO1 enzyme induction. The methanolic extract of fruits demonstrated a concentration-dependent increase in the cancer chemopreventive marker enzyme NQO1 at the protein expression level in a murine hepatoma cell line (Hepa1c1c7). The interaction with Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1) is an essential transcription factor that controls the expression of the NQO1 enzyme. The demonstrated induction of NQO1 by the fruit extract is consistent with a molecular docking study of the effect of dereplicated compounds on the KEAP1 target. Among the dereplicated compounds, hesperidin, naringin, and rutin have been established as promising inducer compounds for the chemopreventive marker NQO1. Our results highlight the E. abyssinica fruit extract as a future chemopreventive lead.
abstract_zh: 通过超高效液相色谱-质谱联用（UPLC-MS）对阿比西尼亚大戟（Euphorbia abyssinica）果实和地上部分提取物进行化学分析，结果显示它们是多种化合物的丰富来源。两种提取物中共鉴定出39种化合物，其中黄酮类化合物和酚类化合物为主要代谢物。使用三种不同的体外实验（DPPH、ABTS和FRAP实验）评估了两种提取物的抗氧化活性。在DPPH实验中，E. abyssinica果实提取物表现出比地上部分提取物更强的活性（IC(50)分别为85.1 ± 1.07和562.3 ± 1.01 μg/mL）。此外，使用ABTS和FRAP实验，果实提取物的抗氧化能力分别为1063.03 ± 37.8和1476.5 ± 95.6，以μM Trolox当量/毫克提取物计算。癌症化学预防的现有标志物之一是诱导II期解毒酶NAD(P)H:醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1），该酶在对抗氧化损伤的细胞保护中发挥重要作用。评估了提取物通过NQO1酶诱导测试其化学预防潜力。果实甲醇提取物在小鼠肝癌细胞系（Hepa1c1c7）中，以浓度依赖性方式增加了癌症化学预防标志酶NQO1的蛋白表达水平。与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）的相互作用是控制NQO1酶表达的关键转录因子。果实提取物对NQO1的诱导作用与去重复化合物对KEAP1靶点效应的分子对接研究结果一致。在去重复化合物中，橙皮苷、柚皮苷和芦丁已被确定为化学预防标志物NQO1的有前景诱导化合物。我们的结果突显了E. abyssinica果实提取物作为未来化学预防先导物的潜力。
